title: Playing a Ball from a Bad Lie
question: Your ball comes to rest in an old footprint in a bunker. What are your options under the Rules of Golf?

choices.text: Take a free drop out of the footprint
Play the ball as it lies or declare it unplayable
Move the ball to a better spot in the bunker without penalty
Ask your opponent for advice and re-drop without penalty

explanation: When your ball is in a difficult lie such as an old footprint, you must either play it as it lies or declare it unplayable, which comes with a penalty.
imagePrompt: A teen boy standing next to his ball in an old footprint in a bunker, looking at the lie thoughtfully, with a wedge in hand.
